findings.statement: (a) Under tight session time the rules leave weeks with fewer trunk rows than without them. Over 600 time-limited plans (30/40/45 min), outside race/post-event weeks: DEV 92 weeks fewer / 35 weeks to zero (34 / 13 profiles); HOLD alone 85 / 32 (31 / 12); UPPER alone 0 / 0; PLANE alone 7 / 3 (3 / 1). HOLD: a rotated front-plank re-established at 2x7 used to fit; the dead-bug row (no rotation alternative left) is dropped by the time fit; the lost row was the defective plank-in-reps. PLANE: the pull that debuts a week later (D-6) settles at 3x10 instead of 3x8 and takes the time of the dead-bug row, which contradicts the author's C.6 claim 'upper-body rules change upper rows only' (tested only at 45-60 min). SQ1-C3 PARTIAL at week level. (b) Routine reviews of a plan under other rules give no adaptation; synthetic only.
findings.ruling: HOLD residual ACCEPTED as a declared limitation (restoring it would keep the plank-in-reps); PLANE residual NOT accepted as is
findings.close_when: (a) HOLD, before its enabling record: the residual and cause declared in the author's record and in the limitation text; a directed test over 30/40/45-min budgets pins the count; no new trunk-free week where the lost row was not a hold. PLANE, after the A-01 fix: the time-budget scan rerun shows no week with fewer trunk rows with PLANE than without, unless the cause is a removed hold; no new dose number. (b) Before non-synthetic use: a reviewed continuation path for plans built under other rules.
